titulo: Analogue is re-releasing its SNES and Genesis consoles with some nice upgrades
cuerpo: Analogue announced new versions of its Super Nt and Mega Sg retro consoles today with a "reworked industrial design" and built-in wireless connectivity for controllers and accessories.
